changes.title: Accurate daily scores
changes.text: The daily calendar shows the run's earned Custom Rules score and retains large values without covering the date.

changes.title: Daily score and save checks
changes.text: Regression checks cover real daily scoring, large-score persistence, older records, optional metadata and Android calendar layout.

changes.title: Record the acceptance finding
changes.text: Keep the reproduced score mismatch, corrected results and remaining physical-device limits with the build's verification record.

commentary: Acceptance found a daily run whose calendar showed133 even though its recorded earned score was266. I corrected the calendar's score source and added compatible long-score storage while retaining original historical integer scores. Multipliers and scoring formulas are unchanged.
